subject: AUDIO8_TTS_0_1B_ONNX_INT8

source_identity.upstream_code_commit_message: Merge pull request #36 from Audio8-AI/onnx-runtime-0.1b-int8 / Add standalone 0.1B INT8 ONNX runtime

source_observations.german_support: Official ONNX model card lists German among 11 supported/recommended languages; the base Preview card describes German as experimental/multilingual rather than primary, so German production quality remains unproven.
source_observations.execution: Official 0.1B runtime uses ONNX Runtime CPUExecutionProvider and is documented/tested for Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64 upstream.

streaming_contract.format: application/x-ndjson carrying base64 s16le PCM chunks
streaming_contract.important_boundary: 557 ms is encoded audio duration per default 12-frame chunk, not measured target TTFA. Actual TTFA also includes prompt prefill, model generation and codec decode.

cancellation_contract.mechanism: threading.Event shared with the active stream
cancellation_contract.polling: stop_event is checked once per generated semantic step inside iter_codes
cancellation_contract.credit_boundary: source semantics only; target cancellation latency and tail audio are unmeasured

openai_compatibility.observed_behavior: source-compatible request shape for wav/pcm, but this route calls full synthesize and is non-streaming in the pinned code
openai_compatibility.integration_consequence: Frank realtime integration should use/adapt the explicit stream route rather than assume OpenAI-compatible route preserves realtime streaming

source_observations.voice_identity: Runtime supports packaged default voice plus local reference voice registration; stable male Frank voice remains a target-runtime acceptance question, not a source fact.

license_boundary.base_preview_model_card_current: Audio8 Community License v1.0 revenue-capped custom license
license_boundary.note: Do not infer legal compatibility from source metadata alone; exact downloaded ONNX artifacts and accompanying license/NOTICE must be frozen and reviewed before shipping.

hypothesis: Audio8 0.1B INT8 ONNX can reduce the resident TTS footprint enough to coexist with the local LLM/ASR stack while still providing acceptable German turn-level speech and cancel responsiveness.
counterhypothesis: Its German quality is too weak, default streaming chunking/prefill makes TTFA too high, or the runtime/license boundary makes it inferior to already-pinned Qwen3-TTS/Magpie/Supertonic/CosyVoice/VibeVoice candidates despite lower memory use.

required_after_runner_gate: freeze full Hugging Face revision and SHA-256 for all consumed model/runtime files
measure cold load and resident RSS/PSS
German fixed-voice TTFA p50/p95 and realtime factor on canonical short/medium prompts
German intelligibility using independent ASR WER/CER plus human spot check
repeated same-speaker stability and male Frank reference identity
compare chunk_frames 12 vs smaller bounded values without glitch/repetition regression
verify zero outbound model/TTS API calls

negative_evidence_preserved: German is not the base model's primary language and quality is explicitly more variable outside Chinese/English.
The OpenAI-compatible speech route is non-streaming at pinned source.
Default streaming emits only after 12 codec frames per chunk; target TTFA is therefore not implied by the presence of a streaming endpoint.
Exact target-consumed artifact digest set is not yet observed.
License metadata differs between the base Preview model and the official ONNX/code surfaces.
